cases.error_scope: Grid discretization of the stated finite-interval continuum problem

cases.reference_method: Second-order convergence of a smooth centered quadratic potential at fixed finite domain

cases.reference_method: Harmonic continuum reference with finite-domain enlargement at constant spacing

error_separation.domain_sensitivity: Difference between domains at the same grid spacing and physical centered potential
error_separation.grid_error: Fixed-domain grid dependence measured separately by B05
error_separation.limitation: Domain sensitivity is a measurement, not a rigorous bound on finite-domain truncation error

limitations: Acceptance applies only to the declared smooth, well-scaled reference inputs.

No agreement with measured physical experiments or unsupported model is certified.
